November 6, 2019

Hon. Scott S. Harris 
Clerk of the Court 
Supreme Court of the United States 
One First Street, N.E. 
Washington, D.C. 20543 

Re:  Romag Fasteners, Inc. v. Fossil, Inc., No. 18-1233 

Dear Mr. Harris, 

We  represent  Respondents  in  the  above-referenced  matter.    The  brief  for 
Respondents  is  currently  due  on  November  26,  2019.    Respondents  respectfully 
request  a  one-day  extension  of  time  to  file  their  response,  to  and  including 
Wednesday,  November  27,  2019.    Counsel  for  Petitioner  has  consented  to  this 
extension. 

The extension is warranted because of a press of other matters undersigned 
counsel is handling that are pending in this Court and other courts, including filing 
deadlines in other matters on November 25 and November 26, and preparation for 
argument in McKinney v. Arizona, No. 18-1109, on December 11.   

Thank you for your consideration. 

Respectfully submitted, 

/s/ Neal Kumar Katyal 
Neal Kumar Katyal 
Counsel for Respondents 

cc:    Lisa S. Blatt, Counsel of Record for Petitioner, Williams & Connolly LLP
